title: Execute numeric memory records through the KOKKOS adapter
problem: Kokkos stdout can succeed while numeric conversion or bounded output counts in accelerator memory are wrong.
example:
host mirror -> deep_copy(device_input) -> parallel_for(format_record)
-> create_mirror_view_and_copy(HostSpace, device_output) -> serialize
design: Require the requested DefaultExecutionSpace, deep-copy input through a host mirror, format into a device View with parallel_for, and copy a HostSpace mirror back before serialization and finalization.
tradeoffs: Runtime execution remains hardware-dependent; source-generation and host record tests validate structure but do not establish accelerator execution.
docs: The memory launcher formats on the selected backend and copies records to the host for byte-exact oracle comparison. Stdout control failure does not hide memory outcomes.
